items.summary: Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private and reject sitemap, monetization, public-launch, and production work this cycle. The owner must choose keep-private, bounded beta, or full launch after the applicable evidence gates are complete.

Keep searchwoot.com private. Reject sitemap, monetization, public-launch, telemetry, credential, infrastructure, schedule, deployment, and other production work this cycle. The available evidence supports only the reported $4.92 commission, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21; site attribution and analytics are incomplete, so site revenue, margin, ROI, CAC, payback, forecasts, and experiment impact remain unsupported. Owner must choose keep-private, bounded beta after all applicable gates, or full launch after all applicable gates.

Retain only three reversible metadata-only task-routing corrections: 0daynews.com daily briefing to content-writer, allthingsmasonic.com performance task to seo-analyst, and americastrikes.com affiliate replacement task to content-writer. No site code, content, links, schedules, credentials, deployment, telemetry, spending, or production changes are authorized. Defer the remaining queue candidates because the action cap is three.
Existing deployed improvements may continue scheduled measurement. Do not duplicate experiments or declare success without recorded outcome data and thresholds.
